claims.text: docs/adr/README.md holds the ADR list and its rules: an accepted ADR is not rewritten; when a decision changes a new ADR records it and the old one only has its status changed to 'Bị thay thế bởi NNNN' with a link.
A design doc (docs/design/) describes how to do one thing and is edited as the plan changes; an ADR points to the design doc instead of copying it.
ADR 0005 header line 3: status 'Bị thay thế bởi' with a link to 0007; README list row for 0005 shows 'Bị thay thế bởi 0007'.
ADR 0005 decision (lines 28-29): full copy per environment, debt taken deliberately — the team knew a better way, chose the quicker one for lack of time to learn a tool, and knew the cost.
ADR 0005 consequences: changes meant for both environments are made twice and a forgotten copy lets them drift unnoticed; promotion is a commit changing the tag in envs/production.

ADR 0005 revisit condition (line 37): look again when changes made twice become frequent. Line 38 says it happened and 0007 replaces it; 0005 was written in Sprint 16, 0007 in Sprint 17, so line 38 was written once 0007 existed.
ADR 0007 header: status Đã chấp nhận; 'Thay thế:' links to 0005; proposed and decided in Sprint 17; decider the team lead; comment deadline end of the first week of Sprint 17.

ADR 0007 context: 0005's reasons no longer hold — services grew from api to Notifications, Payments, RabbitMQ; changes for every environment (probe, securityContext, NetworkPolicy) were made twice; the team forgot a copy at least once.
ADR 0007 decision: Kustomize overlays for Đơn Hàng's own manifests; software maintained by others, such as the ingress controller, is still installed from the chart its project publishes.
After 0007, promotion is an edit of the images entry in the production overlay (before: a tag change in envs/production).

Keeping a superseded ADR intact lets a reader tell a decision that fit its time from one that was wrong when made; editing it to the current system erases its reasons and makes it a weaker design doc.
A reversed decision is judged against the context it had, not the later one; treating reversals as mistakes discourages writing revisit conditions or recording decisions expected to change.
Deleting a superseded ADR loses why the system once worked differently and breaks the 'Thay thế:' link of its replacement; the status line already marks it as no longer in force.
ADR 0005 context: two environments, staging and production, differing in values such as the api replica count and image tag; per 0007 the config repository then held only the api.
